result.rationale: The diff shows `next`/`previous` actions set `group.set("offset", offset)` then call `group.findMembers()`, which performs an ajax call and sets `members`, `user_count`, `offset` from the response with no in-flight guard or request sequencing. Overlapping clicks can resolve out of order and clobber state — a real race introduced by this diff.

judged_text: Pagination clicks race: there is no in-flight guard and responses are not sequenced (offset is updated synchronously before the request), so overlapping requests can resolve out of order and the displayed members/offset/user_count reflect the earlier request rather than the user's last navigation action
